name: release-notes
description: Create release notes from merged pull requests, changelogs, release diffs, and shipped change evidence. Use when the requested artifact is a release note or changelog. Do not use for incidents, postmortems, outage summaries, conceptual explanations, or general PR summaries.

name: incident-response
description: Summarize active incidents, outages, incident pull requests, and postmortems for responders or leadership.

name: pr-review
description: Review diffs for security, accessibility, correctness, and regression risks.

name: migration-planning
description: Plan bounded legacy component or codemod migrations.
